_comment: A claim and the component that proves it.
The other layouts take whatever photograph the rotation lands on, which is
right when the picture is there to be looked at. It is wrong when the post
asserts something mechanical. A post that says the frame locks together by
hand and shows a whole unit on a showroom floor has asserted it twice and
shown it never; the clip that does the locking is a photograph we have.
So here the sentence chooses the picture. 'photo' names a file in
assets/library/parts, and a detail whose file is missing is skipped rather
than drawn empty. 'pillars' is which posts may use it — a rail divider
belongs on a retail post and nowhere else.
Everything claimed here has to be true of the product as shipped. This is
the one layout where the reader can check the words against the picture.

details.claim: The frame locks together by hand.
details.caption: HANDiLOCK post clip. No bolts, no washers, nothing to drop behind the unit.
details.photo: 홈던트 하우스) 기둥 고정클립 B 연출.jpg

details.claim: The only tool in the carton is a mallet.
details.caption: Urethane head: it seats the clip and leaves no mark on the finish.

details.claim: The beam carries the load, not the board.
details.caption: Roll-formed depth and cross beams. The board sits on steel on all four sides.
Anti-scratch and waterproof, and the cut edge is finished like the face.

details.claim: Where the code says anchor it, there is a part for that.
details.caption: Wall bracket. Standard on tall runs in schools, labs and back rooms.

details.claim: A steel post on a soft floor needs a foot.
details.caption: Safety foot. It spreads the load so the post does not sink or scar the floor.

details.claim: A unit that is too short next year is not scrap.
details.caption: Post connector. Add a section and the same run stands taller.

details.claim: Two runs meet in a corner without losing the corner.
details.caption: Corner bracket. The return bay carries load like any other bay.

details.claim: The same unit that stands still can roll.
details.caption: Castor bracket, two and three inch, braked or free.
details.photo: 홈던트 하우스) 바퀴 브래킷 기둥 결합.jpg

details.claim: Open shelving that closes when it has to.
details.caption: Curtain rail and bracket: dust off the stock, and the stock out of sight.
details.photo: 홈던트 하우스) 정면 커튼 브래킷+커튼봉 결합.jpg

details.caption: Rail divider. A bay faced in the morning is still faced at closing.

details.claim: Not everything stacks. Some of it hangs.
details.caption: Hanger rail and support, added to any tier without tools.

details.claim: The upright is not only structure. It is storage.
details.caption: Mesh board and bracket: hooks, tools and small parts off the shelf.

details.claim: One hook, two depths, no second part number.
details.caption: Reversible C hook. Turn it over for the longer reach.
